elements.text:
You just turned in an important paper. As you're checking your submission, you notice you made an embarrassing typo in the first sentence

Here are some thoughts that might pop into mind:

texts: My teacher will think I'm careless and grade the whole paper differently because of it
Most people move past small errors quickly.
One typo doesn't erase the quality of everything that follows it.
Even if I get one or two points off for a typo, my grade will probably be fine.
I feel like the typo is all anyone will notice, but that's not how reading works.
